pages.title: Prisma: Tide of Colors
pages.creator: UP Creative
pages.description: Prisma: Tide of Colors challenges you to dismantle glass constructions by removing accessible screws. Collect matching colors in sets of three, keeping the five reserve spaces from filling. Work through forty stages and spend earned coins on helpful tools and permanent visual finishes.

pages.title: Bubble Hero
pages.creator: Tweensoft
pages.description: Bubble Hero sends you through eighty bubble-shooting stages on a mission to rescue trapped mice. Aim and fire into the bubbles to open a way for them. Collect special items and earn rewards as you clear the obstacles in each rescue puzzle.

pages.title: Box Monster: Unbox & Dress Up
pages.creator: Artem Lanin
pages.description: Box Monster: Unbox & Dress Up combines surprise-box collecting with monster styling. Open a box to discover a figure, then choose outfits and accessories for it. Play puzzle games to earn coins and buy more mystery boxes for the growing collection.

pages.title: Match Dream Garden
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Match Dream Garden asks you to match three identical garden items to complete collection and obstacle-clearing tasks. Earn stars from finished stages to unlock new areas. Hammers, rakes, and gardening gloves provide different ways to remove or rearrange troublesome pieces.

pages.title: Love Colors
pages.creator: SecGame
pages.description: Love Colors lets you decorate an Art Nouveau portrait framed by leaves and flowers. Choose colors from the palette and apply them to the artwork's sections. Zoom in for small details, undo or redo changes, and download the completed colored picture.

pages.title: Frost Land - Snow Survival
pages.creator: Ultra Games Entertainment Private limited
pages.description: Frost Land - Snow Survival puts you in charge of surviving a frozen landscape and expanding a shelter. Use a flamethrower to clear snow and expose useful resources. Manage the supplies you uncover while deciding which frozen areas to explore next.

pages.title: Zen Master - 3 tiles
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Zen Master - 3 tiles asks you to clear picture tiles in matching trios. Select pieces that are uncovered from above and build sets in the bottom bar. Keep the eight-slot tray from filling with unmatched tiles while removing the entire arrangement.

pages.title: Find Sort Match
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: Find Sort Match presents organizing puzzles involving objects with different shapes, colors, and uses. Sort the items and identify matching pieces to complete each arrangement. Work through the separate challenges by deciding how the objects should be grouped and placed together.

pages.title: Stickman Duo: Escape The Tomb
pages.creator: PersistGame
pages.description: Stickman Duo: Escape The Tomb pairs two characters in a maze of boxes, switches, and collectible coins. Switch control between them to solve the route toward the exits. Keep the red character out of blue water and the blue character out of red water.

pages.title: Mobile Phone Case Diy
pages.creator: Yiv.Com
pages.description: Mobile Phone Case Diy gives you a blank phone case to customize with color and decoration. Draw on the surface, mix shades, and use spray paint to build a design. Combine the available tools to create the appearance you want for the case.

pages.title: Paw Clash
pages.creator: Merlot Games
pages.description: Paw Clash puts animal characters into a party competition of different minigames. Run, jump, punch, and grab while carrying out each event's objective. Earn points across the challenges and adapt as their tasks and difficulty change from one round to the next.

pages.title: Love Archer
pages.creator: Mirra Games
pages.description: Love Archer casts you as Cupid solving puzzles with love arrows. Aim at different creatures to bring them together as couples in a magical garden. Work through the arrangements and choose which characters to connect with the bow's matchmaking shots.

pages.title: Click Click Clicker
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Click Click Clicker turns pressing an on-screen button into an idle earning loop. Collect money from clicks and invest in abilities that improve the activity. Unlock additional button designs, cursor styles, visual themes, and music as your clicking progress continues.

pages.title: Puzzle Fever
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Puzzle Fever asks you to drag colored hexagonal block groups into a board until it is filled. Earn coins and points for completed arrangements across several difficulty levels. Use hints when needed and solve each layout without a countdown limiting your planning.

pages.title: Catch the Apple
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Catch the Apple follows a hedgehog gathering food before winter. Examine each clearing and use the available objects to guide it toward every apple. Work out a route past the level's challenges so the hedgehog finishes collecting the fruit before moving on.

pages.title: TAP ME
pages.creator: Synk Inc.
pages.description: TAP ME challenges you to locate people in a crowded scene using a reference photograph. Compare faces and tap the matching person when you spot them. Find every requested character before the time limit expires to complete the current stage.

pages.title: Pirates gold hunters
pages.creator: GamesdMurdock
pages.description: Pirates gold hunters asks you to steer a pirate ship around a level while collecting coins. Click to change its direction and dodge shots fired by an impostor. Gather the full coin supply to advance, keeping the vessel clear of incoming projectiles.

pages.title: The Chess
pages.creator: BUSIDOL
pages.description: The Chess offers traditional chess alongside a variant where the board breaks apart randomly. Plan moves with the chosen rules and customize the board or pieces to your preference. Try the classic contest or adapt your strategy to the changing-board mode.

pages.title: Discolor Master
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Discolor Master is a ranged-combat game featuring bows and other long-distance weapons. Use the color picker and line up shots against the enemies ahead. Move through the combat areas while dealing with different opponents and their return attacks.

pages.title: Mini Steps
pages.creator: NoaDev
pages.description: Mini Steps is a platform puzzle where a small blob moves through fixed jumps. Choose each step carefully to reach every coin without getting trapped by the layout. Work out the order of jumps that lets the blob finish collecting the stage's pickups.

pages.title: Wok Planet
pages.creator: VIR Group
pages.description: Wok Planet puts you in a resistance fighting aliens that have occupied the Woks' home. Drag components into place to build useful mechanisms and vehicles. Combine those constructions with the Woks' abilities to reach the invaders' lair and destroy it.

pages.title: FISHCONNECT
pages.creator: AlexGames!
pages.description: FISHCONNECT asks you to remove matching tiles from a six-by-twelve board before the countdown ends. Select two identical pictures with a clear connecting route that turns no more than twice. Plan the pairs so you can clear the full grid in time.

pages.title: Impostor Assassin
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Impostor Assassin casts you as a knife-wielding intruder aboard a spaceship. Move quietly between the crew and eliminate every living crewmate to complete the mission. Collect coins along the way and spend them on weapon upgrades and increased movement speed.

pages.title: Parking Jam Escape
pages.creator: PLEXYGAME
pages.description: Parking Jam Escape challenges you to rearrange cars in a crowded parking area. Swipe vehicles along their available directions and move them into useful positions. Clear enough space through the arrangement to free the larger collection truck trapped among the cars.

pages.title: Solitaire Mahjong Candy
pages.creator: SOFTGAMES – Mobile Entertainment Services GmbH
pages.description: Solitaire Mahjong Candy replaces traditional tile symbols with sweets in a solitaire-matching puzzle. Remove pairs of identical candies only when the tiles are uncovered and have an open side. Work through the arrangement to clear the board and increase your score.

pages.title: Millionaire: Trivia Game Show
pages.creator: K17 Games
pages.description: Millionaire: Trivia Game Show gives you fifteen multiple-choice questions on the way to a million play dollars. Choose one of four answers at each step and use the four lifelines when needed. Reach the final question by applying your general knowledge carefully.

pages.title: Noob Huggy
pages.creator: FBK
pages.description: Noob Huggy follows a block-world character trying to escape dangerous slimes. Move and double-jump through the stage to collect a key, then use it to activate the exit. Reach the doorway without being caught by the creatures along the route.

pages.title: Hotel Tycoon Empire
pages.creator: Holy Cow Studio
pages.description: Hotel Tycoon Empire puts you in charge of turning a small motel chain into a larger hospitality business. Tap or hold to manage the operation and develop its income. Expand the hotels with additional rooms and floors as the idle business grows.

pages.title: Flashing Square
pages.creator: kidsgamesplay
pages.description: Flashing Square traps a moving ball inside a square whose edges must flash at the right moment. Tap whenever the ball reaches a boundary so it can rebound safely. An early or late flash ends the attempt, making every bounce a timing test.

pages.title: Basket Slam
pages.creator: trezegames
pages.description: Basket Slam asks you to bounce a basketball off a blue platform before scoring through the hoop. Drag to choose the throw and release to launch it. Plan the shot so it strikes the required surface before reaching the basket.

pages.title: Halloween Princess Holiday Castle
pages.creator: DL-studio
pages.description: Halloween Princess Holiday Castle gives you castles to decorate for a seasonal celebration. Choose furniture and arrange candles, pumpkins, cobwebs, and other eerie accessories. Add guests in costumes such as vampires, ghosts, and fairies to complete the princesses' Halloween party setting.

pages.title: Arkadium's Flip Out
pages.creator: Arkadium
pages.description: Arkadium's Flip Out is a timed memory challenge with unusual card pairings. Turn over cards, remember the pictures revealed, and find their matching partners. Clear the required matches before the countdown expires as the different themed cards change what you need to recognize.

pages.title: Steve AdventureCraft Aqua
pages.creator: FBK
pages.description: Steve AdventureCraft Aqua sends Steve into underwater stages filled with hostile creatures. Collect fish and slime while finding a route through the submerged world. Watch for the monsters throughout each level and keep the character moving safely toward the next part of the adventure.

pages.title: Wild West Clash
pages.creator: G55.CO
pages.description: Wild West Clash puts you in multiplayer gunfights across frontier-themed maps. Move, jump, crouch, and aim at opposing gunslingers using the available weapons. Defeat rival players during each round while navigating the shooting positions in the different Wild West locations.

pages.title: Ninja Clash Heroes
pages.creator: Freeway Interactive
pages.description: Ninja Clash Heroes places your team in an oriental garden defending a Fortune Cat from enemies. Choose a hero such as a ninja scout, samurai, monk, or sniper and join the fight. Move, aim, and use grenades to support the squad's defense.

pages.title: Drop Letters
pages.creator: nau.games
pages.description: Drop Letters asks you to build words by arranging the supplied letters. Drag the appropriate characters into their positions and check how they complete the answer. Finish the word-building activities as you practice recognizing where each missing letter belongs.

pages.title: Hard Wheels 2
pages.creator: SDV Imants Klava
pages.description: Hard Wheels 2 challenges you to balance a monster truck over difficult obstacles. Accelerate, brake, and adjust the vehicle's angle to reach the finish quickly. Aim for a three-star time and unlock achievements while learning how to handle each off-road course.

pages.title: Candy Blocks Collapse
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Candy Blocks Collapse asks you to select groups of at least two matching sweets. Clear larger clusters for more points, and remove six or more together to create a bomb. Choose useful groups to make space and improve the score from your next collapse.

pages.title: Ping Pong
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Ping Pong gives you a table-tennis opponent in a race to ten points. Move the paddle quickly or slowly to change shot speed and add spin to your returns. Keep the rally going while finding angles that send the ball past the other player.

pages.title: Vegetables Collection
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Vegetables Collection challenges you to chain adjacent matching crops before the time limit expires. Connect at least three horizontally, vertically, or diagonally to collect them. Longer chains provide bonuses, including extra time, as you work toward the level's required vegetable totals.

pages.title: Plant Love
pages.creator: nau.games
pages.description: Plant Love lets you care for a potted plant through a sequence of simple choices. Use the water, sunlight, and affection buttons to respond to what it needs. Watch the plant pass through its growth stages as you provide the requested care.

pages.title: Wall Breaker
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Wall Breaker is an arcade game about smashing walls. Use the mouse-controlled action to destroy the barriers and continue through the levels as you work to clear the path in front of the character.

pages.title: No Driver Parking
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: No Driver Parking lets you draw the route a car will follow into its parking space. Sketch a path around objects and other vehicles, then guide the car to its destination. Plan the turns carefully so the automatic drive finishes without a collision.

pages.title: Air Combat 2D
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Air Combat 2D puts you into two-dimensional aerial battles and dogfights. Take part in the air war, engage opposing aircraft, and react to the threats around your plane. Work through the combat using the game's tap-based controls to keep fighting in the sky.

pages.title: Push the block
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Push the block gives you a puzzle of blocks and pushers to activate. Choose the order of pushes and move the pieces through the arrangement. Work out which pusher to use next so each action helps complete the current layout.

pages.title: Basketball Shot
pages.creator: pogames.in
pages.description: Basketball Shot gives you a touch-controlled challenge about getting a ball into the basket. Take your shots at the hoop and work on directing the ball accurately through the target.

pages.title: Indian Cargo Truck Simulator
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Indian Cargo Truck Simulator puts a heavy trailer full of goods on winding hill roads. Transport loads such as drums, pallets, and gas cylinders to their destinations. Steer and brake carefully through the curves while guiding the cargo truck along the difficult route.

pages.title: Indiara and the skull gold
pages.creator: Pro_Gaming
pages.description: Indiara and the skull gold challenges you to collect golden skulls while escaping a pursuing roller. Tap or click to jump past the dangers along the route. Reach the end safely and try to gather every skull before the chase catches up.

pages.title: Pizza Maker
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Pizza Maker lets you assemble a pizza using ingredients of your choice. Select the toppings, prepare the creation, and bake it in the oven. Complete the cooking activity by slicing the finished pizza after deciding what kind of combination to make.

pages.title: Magic Owl Coloring
pages.creator: Shunda Inc
pages.description: Magic Owl Coloring gives you eight owl drawings to decorate. Choose colors and fill the illustrations to create a separate magical-looking bird for each page. Use the camera button to capture the artwork when you want to show the completed colored image.

pages.title: Cute Trucks For Kids Coloring
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description: Cute Trucks For Kids Coloring offers eight truck illustrations and 23 colors to apply. Pick a picture, color its different sections, and finish quickly for a stronger score. Save the resulting image after completing your chosen color scheme for the vehicle.

pages.title: Doll Sister Throat Doctor
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Doll Sister Throat Doctor asks you to treat Super Doll's sister in a playful medical visit. Examine her throat with the magnifier, use a laser to remove germs, and apply cream to affected areas. Complete the treatment activities to help the character recover.

pages.title: Pool Buddy
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Pool Buddy challenges you to get a ragdoll into a swimming pool using a slingshot. Drag to aim the launch and judge how its impact will move Buddy. Work through the stages by sending the character toward the water with carefully chosen shots.

pages.title: Dog Rush
pages.creator: kalem
pages.description: Dog Rush asks you to connect matching dog pictures by dragging through neighboring pieces. Clear chains to earn points while watching the timer and the current level's target. Build useful connections among the five dog types to keep the matching challenge progressing.

pages.title: Tank VS Minions
pages.creator: Arcade Lemon
pages.description: Tank VS Minions puts you in control of a tank fighting incoming minions. Move the vehicle into position and fire bullets at the approaching enemies. Keep responding to their positions as you work to shoot each minion in the tank battle.

pages.title: Sword Master
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Sword Master puts you in sword fights against successive enemies. Use the mouse-controlled attacks to damage opposing fighters before they take away your health. Continue through the encounters and work with the available weapons as the next enemy arrives.

pages.title: Boys With Glasses Jigsaw
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Boys With Glasses Jigsaw offers twelve pictures with three puzzle difficulties each. Choose twenty-five, forty-nine, or one hundred pieces for the selected image. Drag the sections into their correct places until the complete picture of the glasses-wearing character is restored.

pages.title: Lover Worm
pages.creator: Parrot Games
pages.description: Lover Worm sends a worm through a route of obstacles using jumping and digging movements. Choose when to rise above the ground or pass beneath it while collecting coins. Protect the worm's health and unlock other characters as you extend the journey.

pages.title: Army Truck Transport
pages.creator: AdoLuxGames
pages.description: Army Truck Transport gives you three military trucks and ten delivery stages. Take cargo to the next base before the time limit expires, keeping the load aboard over obstacles. Control the truck carefully so loose goods do not fall during the journey.

pages.title: Choo Choo Connect
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Choo Choo Connect asks you to link train stations sharing the same color. Draw rail routes between each pair while keeping them from crossing tracks belonging to other colors. Complete all the connections by leaving enough space for every station's path.

pages.title: Hyper Goalkeeper Party
pages.creator: Polygon Game Studio
pages.description: Hyper Goalkeeper Party puts two goals under your control at once. Move the defenders with the mouse and react to the ball's position to protect both openings. Keep watching each side as you try to prevent shots from reaching either net.

pages.title: Dress Night
pages.creator: Bnagames
pages.description: Dress Night helps Jenny prepare for an evening out. Browse the clothing choices and put together an outfit for the party, then choose where she will go. Complete the styling session by finding a combination that fits her planned night-time outing.

pages.title: Extreme Impossible Tracks Stunt Car Racing 3D
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Extreme Impossible Tracks Stunt Car Racing 3D puts your car on elevated tracks high above the ground. Steer through the narrow racing routes, brake for difficult sections, and compete against rival drivers. Keep the vehicle on the sky course as you attempt its stunt-driving challenges.

pages.title: Word Wonders
pages.creator: Arwin Margallo
pages.description: Word Wonders asks you to connect letters into words across a large collection of puzzles. Try different combinations to find the answers needed by the current stage. Complete each word set to continue through more than a thousand vocabulary challenges.

pages.title: FG Jigsaw Puzzle
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: FG Jigsaw Puzzle asks you to rebuild pictures from shuffled pieces. Drag sections into place and fit adjoining details together until they form the complete image. Work through the available puzzles by comparing each piece with the spaces still missing from the picture.

pages.title: BTS Elephant Coloring
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: BTS Elephant Coloring gives you elephant pictures to decorate with your own palette. Change the brush thickness for large areas or small details, then add extra scenery such as sky or paths. Finish each drawing with the colors and background additions you choose.

pages.title: Ball Blast
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Ball Blast puts you in control of a moving blaster firing at bouncing stones. Hit each stone until its health is depleted, then deal with the smaller pieces it releases. Collect coins and improve the weapon's firing power or speed between attempts.

pages.title: Red Ball Forever
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Red Ball Forever follows a red ball rolling, bouncing, and floating through a world threatened by monsters. Avoid Black Ball's traps and work toward the end of each stage. Collect stars along the route to unlock additional appearances for the ball.

pages.title: Basketball School
pages.creator: oneru220
pages.description: Basketball School offers three shooting challenges with different limits. Arcade mode removes balls when you miss, Time Attack runs until the countdown ends, and the distance mode shortens the range after misses. Drag to aim and release to send each shot toward the hoop.

pages.title: EG Gold Miner
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: EG Gold Miner challenges you to pull valuables from a mine with a lowering winch. Collect gold, silver, gemstones, and bonus bags to reach the stage's score target. Avoid explosive barrels and spend earnings in the shop on improvements for later mining attempts.

pages.title: Karate Chop Kick
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Karate Chop Kick challenges you to strike wooden training targets before time runs out. Tap to chop and kick as quickly as the exercise demands. Build a higher score during training and unlock advanced characters, including Chuck and Sam, for later attempts.

pages.title: Avoid It
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Avoid It asks you to guide a character past hazardous obstacles using finger movement. Adjust the route as the barriers appear and keep the character clear of danger. Continue dodging through the changing arrangement to extend the arcade attempt.

pages.title: Tank Forces: Survival
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Tank Forces: Survival tasks you with protecting allied forces while waiting for reinforcements. Drive the tank, aim at enemy threats, and switch weapons when needed. Keep the defense going long enough for help to arrive and turn the battle in your favor.

pages.title: Ride The Bus Simulator
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Ride The Bus Simulator puts a bomb on a bus's brakes, making slowing down a dangerous decision. Choose from four vehicles and keep driving without triggering the brake-connected explosive. Negotiate the route while remembering that using the brake restarts the attempt.

pages.title: Idle Evolve
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: Idle Evolve has you open boxes and combine matching characters to develop their evolution. Earn coins over time and spend them on upgrades that increase income or shorten waiting periods. Keep merging the figures and opening new boxes to expand the idle operation.

pages.title: BFF Fest Festival
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: BFF Fest Festival follows Ariel and Rapunzel preparing for Oktoberfest in Germany. Look through the clothing selection and choose an outfit for each friend. Coordinate their appearances so both princesses are ready to attend the festival together.

pages.title: Avocado Toast Instagram
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Avocado Toast Instagram turns preparing a colorful toast plate into a cooking activity. Work through the ingredient-cutting and preparation steps to create the avocado dish. Assemble the finished food into a plate inspired by the breakfast pictures associated with Instagram.

pages.title: Football Penalty Champions
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Football Penalty Champions puts the outcome of a tied football match on your spot-kicking ability. Take the penalty and try to get the ball past the keeper. Work on the timing of your attempts as you aim to secure the decisive goal.

pages.title: Best Princess Awards
pages.creator: Games Banner Network
pages.description: Best Princess Awards asks you to prepare your chosen princess for an annual award ceremony. Browse glamorous dresses and more unusual fashion options to create her look. Help her choose an outfit suited to making an appearance at the princesses' celebration.

pages.title: Christmas Tree Decorations
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Christmas Tree Decorations combines dressing a princess for cold weather with preparing a holiday tree. Choose suitable clothing first, then arrange the tree's decorations. Complete the seasonal styling and decorating activities to finish her outdoor Christmas preparation scene.

pages.title: Christmas Santa Claus Rush
pages.creator: dreamgamestudio@gmail.com
pages.description: Christmas Santa Claus Rush sends Santa on a holiday gift-delivery run. Jump along the route and help him carry presents to children as you complete the stages. Each successful passage awards a mystery gift, with twelve different surprises available to discover.

pages.title: Princess Night Out in Hollywood
pages.creator: MyCuteGames
pages.description: Princess Night Out in Hollywood helps Elsa, Cinderella, and Jasmine get ready for a party-filled evening. Choose sparkling clothing and makeup for the three princesses. Prepare the group before deciding between the different Hollywood clubs they may visit that night.

pages.title: Boat Rush
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Boat Rush sends an armed speedboat through twisting rivers and canals. Steer around the course, shoot threats, and use waves to launch into stunts. Collect power-ups and work with upgrades as you try to carry the boat through the high-speed ride.

pages.title: Ultimate Word Search
pages.creator: Happylander Ltd
pages.description: Ultimate Word Search hides hundreds of words across puzzles in different categories. Scan the letter grids and mark the terms you discover. Choose a topic and keep finding its hidden answers until the current word-search challenge is complete.

pages.title: Clown Nights
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Clown Nights puts you on a circus night shift with hostile clowns roaming the premises. Watch their movements through cameras and use doors and lights to protect your position. Manage the remaining power while trying to survive the night without a clown reaching you.

pages.title: Mysterious Jewels
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Mysterious Jewels is a matching puzzle controlled by shifting entire rows of gems. Drag a row to bring matching jewels together and remove the resulting groups. Plan the board changes carefully as you work through the level's jewel-clearing objectives.

pages.title: Cindy Wedding Shopping
pages.creator: DariaGames.com
pages.description: Cindy Wedding Shopping joins a bride-to-be searching for her wedding outfit. Visit the shop, try different dresses, and compare them before choosing one. Add an elegant veil and a colorful bouquet to finish Cindy's appearance for the ceremony.
